ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda PlugX DLL side-loading via co-located signed loader in user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts Mustang Panda's (RedDelta / Earth Preta / Stately Taurus) signature PlugX install chain: a legitimately-signed executable dropped to a user-writable directory side-loads a malicious DLL co-located in the same folder, which then decrypts an adjacent encrypted payload (.dat). This loader-DLL-payload triad in a non-system path is the group's most consistent tradecraft across campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Users\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\Public\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*")) AND NOT (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Windows\\*","*\\Program Files*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval dir=replace(file_path,"[^\\\\]+$","") | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(file_name) as files dc(eval(if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.exe$"),1,null()))) as has_exe dc(eval(if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.dll$"),1,null()))) as has_dll dc(eval(if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.(dat|bin|dll\.config|cfg)$"),1,null()))) as has_payload by dest dir | where has_exe>=1 AND has_dll>=1 AND has_payload>=1 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let UserWritable = dynamic(["\\users\\","\\programdata\\","\\appdata\\","\\public\\","\\perflogs\\","\\temp\\"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
// PlugX hallmark: the loaded DLL sits in the SAME folder as the loader EXE (side-load)
| where tolower(FolderPath) == tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| where tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath) has_any (UserWritable)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith "C:\\Windows\\"
     and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith "C:\\Program Files"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
// enrich: confirm an adjacent encrypted payload (.dat/.bin) was written to the same dir
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".dat" or FileName endswith ".bin"
    | project DeviceId, PayloadDir = tolower(FolderPath), PayloadFile = FileName
  ) on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceId
| where PayloadDir == tolower(FolderPath) or isempty(PayloadDir)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          LegitLoaderExe = InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          SideloadedDll = FileName, DllSHA256 = SHA256,
          LoaderSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256, PayloadFile
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
// signed/legit loader binary masquerading from a user-writable dir (no Sentinel image-load table — approximate via the loader exec)
| where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Users|ProgramData|AppData|Public|PerfLogs|Temp)\\"
| where ActingProcessName !matches regex @"(?i)\\(Windows|Program Files)"
| where isnotempty(ActingProcessFileCompany) and ActingProcessFileCompany !contains "Microsoft"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          LegitLoaderExe = ActingProcessName, CmdLine = ActingProcessCommandLine,
          Company = ActingProcessFileCompany, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Mustang Panda PlugX DLL Side-Load From User-Writable Path
id: 7a1c9e22-3b4d-4f8a-9c11-9e2b6d0fa401
status: experimental
description: Detects a DLL loaded from the same user-writable directory as its loading process, the PlugX side-loading hallmark used by Mustang Panda / RedDelta.
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    ImageLoaded|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.dll'
  filter_system:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Windows\'
      - '\Program Files'
  condition: selection_path and not filter_system
falsepositives:
  - Portable applications that bundle DLLs in user directories
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 (@ImageLoaded:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\users\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\appdata\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\public\\*)) @ImageLoaded:(*.dll OR *.DLL) -@Image:(*\\Windows\\* OR *\\windows\\* OR *\\Program?Files* OR *\\program?files*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(Users|ProgramData|AppData|Public|PerfLogs|Temp)\\/i
| NOT (ImageFileName=/\\(Windows|Program Files)\\/i)
| regex("(?i)\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName], function=([count(as=execs), min(_time, as=firstSeen), collect([SHA256HashData, CommandLine])]))
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: DLL side-loading via a legit signed binary + co-located malicious DLL + encrypted .dat payload dropped to a user-writable path is Mustang Panda's most durable, cross-campaign signature for staging PlugX (and its Hodur/THOR variants). Generic side-load rules fire on any portable app; anchoring on the loader-in-user-path + co-located DLL + adjacent encrypted payload triad isolates the PlugX deployme
_sigma_issues: no MITRE ATT&CK tag (expected at least one `attack.t####`)

ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda PlugX USB worm propagation (removable-drive LNK + hidden loader copy)
ucs.description: Hunts the self-propagating PlugX/HodurRAT USB worm used by Mustang Panda (Earth Preta / TA416): shortly after a removable drive mounts, a non-system process writes a hidden directory plus the legit-loader EXE/DLL and decoy .lnk files to the drive root to spread to air-gapped hosts. This removable-media replication is a distinctive Earth Preta behaviour.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path IN ("D:\\*","E:\\*","F:\\*","G:\\*","H:\\*","I:\\*","J:\\*","K:\\*") AND NOT Filesystem.process_path IN ("*\\explorer.exe","*\\System32\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval is_lnk=if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.lnk$"),1,0), is_exe=if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.exe$"),1,0), is_dll=if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.dll$"),1,0) | stats sum(is_lnk) as lnk_writes sum(is_exe) as exe_writes sum(is_dll) as dll_writes values(file_name) as files min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user process_name process_path | where lnk_writes>=1 AND (exe_writes>=1 OR dll_writes>=1) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 10m;
// removable drive mount events
let Mounts = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "UsbDriveMounted"
    | project DeviceId, MountTime = Timestamp, DriveLetter = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).DriveLetter);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
// writes to a non-system drive root (removable target)
| where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !contains "explorer.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName endswith ".lnk" or FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".dat"
| join kind=inner Mounts on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (MountTime .. MountTime + Window)
| summarize WrittenFiles = make_set(FileName), LnkCount = countif(FileName endswith ".lnk"),
            PayloadCount = countif(FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll"),
            FirstWrite = min(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, DriveLetter
| where LnkCount >= 1 and PayloadCount >= 1   // LNK lure + loader copied together = worm staging
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where TargetFilePath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
| where ActingProcessName !contains "explorer.exe"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend Ext = tolower(TargetFileExtension)
| where Ext in ("lnk","exe","dll","dat")
| summarize WrittenFiles = make_set(TargetFileName), LnkCount = countif(Ext == "lnk"),
            PayloadCount = countif(Ext in ("exe","dll")), FirstWrite = min(TimeGenerated)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName
| where LnkCount >= 1 and PayloadCount >= 1
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(D\:\\* OR E\:\\* OR F\:\\* OR G\:\\* OR H\:\\*) @TargetFilename:(*.lnk OR *.LNK OR *.exe OR *.EXE OR *.dll OR *.DLL OR *.dat) -@Image:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\System32\\* OR *\\system32\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/^[D-Z]:\\/i
| regex("(?i)\\.(lnk|exe|dll|dat)$", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\explorer\.exe$/i)
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\System32\\/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=([count(as=writes), collect([TargetFileName]), min(_time, as=firstSeen)]))
| regex("(?i)\\.lnk", field=TargetFileName)
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Self-spreading PlugX via USB — copying the legit-loader EXE/DLL into a hidden directory on the drive root plus decoy .lnk files that re-launch the loader — is a hallmark of Mustang Panda / Earth Preta (documented by Trend Micro and Avast/Hodur reporting) and is how they reach air-gapped and segmented targets aligned to their state espionage mission.
